subject: Fix Attribute::unescape_value does not unescape predefined entities since #739
summary: After PR #739 reorganised attribute decoding around `normalized_value_with`, the entry-point method `Attribute::normalized_value` was wired to a `|_| None` resolver instead of `resolve_predefined_entity`, so the five XML predefined entity references (`<`, `>`, `'`, `"`) other than `&` were rejected with `EscapeError::UnrecognizedEntity`.
